direction_conventions.isomer_reverse: B(15/2->19/2)=(20/16) B(19/2->15/2), both in the same ordinary units
direction_conventions.special_0_to_2_reference: 5 times the ordinary downward reference; coefficient approximately 0.297
direction_conventions.avoid_extra_spin_factor: Compare an already normalized downward B directly to the converted datum; do not divide by 20 again.

localized_documentation_findings.finding: General downward formula is explicit. The following prose specifies 0+->2+ but its 0.297 expression is labelled with a downward arrow.
localized_documentation_findings.assessment: 0.297 is the rounded fivefold 0->2 reference; its downward-arrow label conflicts with the surrounding context, not an error in the fivefold coefficient.

localized_documentation_findings.finding: The page names T_gamma a partial half-life, then prints dimensionless B as T_gamma/T_W.
localized_documentation_findings.assessment: At fixed energy/multipolarity with matched radiative times, B/BW=T_W/T_gamma. The printed reciprocal is a hindrance ratio; the alpha=0 single-branch limit already exposes the reversal.
localized_documentation_findings.scope: Specific archived help expression; no assertion that ENSDF datasets or NNDC as a whole are invalid.

independent_textbook_locator.edition: Bohr and Mottelson, Nuclear Structure I, first edition 1969; local World Scientific 1998 edition
independent_textbook_locator.basis: Radiative rate proportional to E^(2L+1) B; the book's T(E2) is a rate per second, not a half-life.
independent_textbook_locator.inspection: Local PDF text; no textbook page reproduction written.

parent_model_protocol_boundary: Parent fixes primary ordinal 0/0 and an energy-only alternative before B; this sidecar neither selects states nor calculates any model strength.
